trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User provides patient ID and policy number, asking if the policy covers the entire cost.
steps.text: माझं patient ID PT-2004 आणि policy POL-55504 आहे. मला check करायचंय की policy मध्ये पूर्ण खर्च cover होईल का?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask for an identity verification factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant asks for a non-sensitive knowledge factor to verify identity before discussing policy details.
steps.text: नक्कीच, मी तुम्हाला मदत करतो. Verification साठी तुमची date of birth सांगू शकाल का?
steps.planner_rationale: Before looking up policy details, the caller's identity must be verified using a knowledge factor.

steps.purpose: User provides their date of birth.
Verify the caller's identity using the provided date of birth.
Confirm verification and state that policy details are being checked.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant confirms successful verification and transitions to looking up the policy.
steps.text: धन्यवाद, verification पूर्ण झाले आहे. मी तुमचे policy details check करतो.
steps.planner_rationale: Identity is verified, so the assistant can now proceed to check the policy coverage.

steps.purpose: Return policy coverage details including balance and sum insured.
Inform the user of their balance and ask for procedure details to check if the cost is fully covered.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant states the available balance from the tool result and asks for procedure and room category to estimate costs.
steps.text: तुमची CareIns ची policy active आहे आणि तुमचा balance ४५,००० रुपये आहे. पूर्ण खर्च cover होईल का हे पाहण्यासाठी, procedure कोणती आहे आणि room category कोणती हवी आहे?
steps.planner_rationale: To answer if the policy covers the whole thing, the assistant needs to compare the balance against the procedure estimate.

steps.purpose: User specifies the procedure and room category, with an STT error on the word 'operation'.
steps.text: gallbladder चे ऑपरेशन आहे, general ward मध्ये.
steps.clean_text: gallbladder चे ऑपरेशन आहे, general ward मध्ये.
steps.model_visible_text: gallbladder चे ऑक्युपेशन आहे, general ward मध्ये.

steps.purpose: Get the cost estimate for the requested procedure and room category.
Return the package estimate for the procedure.
Start explaining the shortfall between the package estimate and the available balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant begins to explain the financial shortfall but is designed to be interrupted.
steps.text: हॉस्पिटलचे package estimate ६५,००० रुपये आहे. तुमचा balance ४५,००० असल्यामुळे, उरलेली रक्कम...
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant must inform the user that the 65k estimate exceeds the 45k balance, setting up the user barge-in.

steps.purpose: User interrupts the assistant, disputing the figures and demanding an explanation.
steps.text: एक मिनिट, ६५,००० कसे आले? आणि माझा balance ४५,००० कसा? माझी sum insured २ लाख आहे!

steps.purpose: Recover from the interruption, substantiate the figures using tool data, and ask to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant handles the interruption, substantiates the figures from tool results, and resumes the flow without repeating the interrupted sentence.
steps.text: तुमची sum insured २ लाख आहे हे बरोबर आहे, पण CareIns च्या रेकॉर्डनुसार तुमचा सध्याचा balance ४५,००० रुपये आहे. आणि ६५,००० हे general ward चे package estimate आहे. मी ४५,००० रुपयांसाठी pre-authorisation submit करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant addresses the sceptical user's challenge by citing the insurer's record for the balance and the hospital's estimate for the cost, then asks for permission to submit.

steps.purpose: User accepts the explanation and authorizes the pre-authorisation submission.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, तुम्ही submit करा. मी insurer कडे check करतो balance का कमी दाखवतोय ते.

steps.purpose: Submit the pre-authorisation request for the available balance.
Return the pre-authorisation submission status and decision window.
Confirm the submission, provide the ID, and state the insurer's decision window without promising approval.
steps.expected_behavior: Assistant confirms submission and states the decision window without promising approval, conforming to BR_PA_01.
steps.text: तुमची pre-authorisation request submit झाली आहे. तुमचा ID PA-9912 आहे. CareIns कडून ४ तासात decision येईल. त्यानंतर उरलेल्या रकमेचे payment तुम्हाला करावे लागेल.
steps.planner_rationale: The transaction is complete. The assistant provides the reference ID and decision timeline, explicitly avoiding any guarantee of approval.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
